clue.text: Contemplated taking doctor around practice

indicators.note: the doctor's letters go around the practice word, enclosing it

parts.note: MD is a Doctor of Medicine
use means habit or practice

explanation.surface: Someone thought things over while a GP looked into their routine.
explanation.definitionFit: To muse is to ponder, so mused means pondered at length.

clue.text: Does the local one sit on an ale-bench?

definitions.text: Does the local one sit on an ale-bench?

parts.words: Does the local one sit on an ale-bench?
parts.note: a justice sits on the bench; 'local' teases a pub, hence the ale-bench

explanation.definitionFit: A justice of the peace presides from the bench of a local court.

clue.text: Nervous, being hanged

explanation.definitionFit: Tense and anxious; also suspended by the neck from a gallows.

clue.text: Day begins with sherry, sadly, in some bars

definitions.note: a musical direction marking certain bars of a score

indicators.note: the day letter stands at the front of the sherry

parts.note: oloroso is a rich dark sherry

explanation.surface: A day that starts with sherry ends in sorrow at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bars' are bars of music, not pubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Doloroso is an Italian performance marking meaning mournfully.

clue.text: Irregular soldier trained in Sparta

indicators.note: trained hints at the letters being drilled into a new formation

explanation.surface: A guerrilla fighter was schooled in ancient Sparta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trained' rearranges the eight letters of IN SPARTA.
explanation.definitionFit: A partisan is a guerrilla fighter in an unofficial armed band.

clue.text: Defile ticket

definitions.meaning: a permit or free admission card

explanation.definitionFit: A narrow mountain route; also a permit granting entry.

clue.text: For example, Capricorn subject accepting reading at the outset

indicators.note: the subject word takes in a letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a topic is a subject

indicators.note: only the opening letter of reading is used

explanation.surface: A star sign is a theme that begins with a horoscope reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Capricorn is one of the two lines of latitude bounding the tropics.

clue.text: Remove skin from pickle

explanation.definitionFit: To graze off a surface; also a jam or awkward predicament.

clue.text: Common grub found in oregano shoots

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words oregano shoots

explanation.surface: A caterpillar is discovered on herb sprouts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grub' is food, not a larva; 'Common' marks slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Nosh is informal British slang for food.

clue.text: Stupid to travel with marine subordinate

parts.note: to go is to travel
RM stands for Royal Marine(s)
less can mean lower in rank or inferior

explanation.surface: It seems foolish to set off with a junior marine.
explanation.definitionFit: Gormless is British slang for dim-witted or lacking sense.

clue.text: Messy hit-and-run?

parts.note: to slap is to hit
to dash is to run

explanation.surface: A traffic accident where the driver strikes and flees.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase hit-and-run is split into two pieces, with 'and' joining them.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapdash work is careless and untidy.

clue.text: Old rates of exchange? They can be tight on one!

definitions.text: They can be tight on one!

indicators.note: rates of exchange suggests swapping letters around

explanation.surface: Historic currency rates, quipped as clothes that cling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchange' rearranges the letters of OLD RATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Leotards are close-fitting one-piece garments for dancers and gymnasts.

clue.text: Gran's a1 compound drunk in Spain

indicators.note: compound means mix together, so the letters are blended

parts.note: the possessive s is used as a letter here
the 1 is read as the letter I beside A

explanation.surface: Grandma's first-rate concoction is what people drink in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compound' mixes GRANS with A and I (1 read as a letter).
explanation.definitionFit: Sangria is a Spanish punch of red wine and fruit.

clue.text: Draw together a line of horses, opening Epsom

parts.note: a string is a stable's set of racehorses

indicators.note: only the opening letter of Epsom is used

explanation.surface: A team of racehorses leads off at Epsom, the racecourse in Surrey.
explanation.definitionFit: To astringe is to constrict or contract tissue.

clue.text: Random examination in the dermatology clinic?

definitions.meaning: a check made without warning on a sample
a skin doctor would literally examine blemishes

explanation.definitionFit: An unannounced inspection; humorously, also a look at skin blemishes.

clue.text: Repeated blows to bring people round, paradoxically?

definitions.text: Repeated blows to bring people round, paradoxically?

parts.words: Repeated blows to bring people round, paradoxically?
parts.note: blows are breaths into the lungs, not punches, that revive someone

explanation.definitionFit: Mouth-to-mouth resuscitation is a first-aid rescue technique.

clue.text: Felicity to commandeer promontory

parts.note: to appropriate is to seize for one's own use
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness place names

explanation.surface: A woman called Felicity seizes a headland.
explanation.walkthrough: Felicity is not a name here but means aptness of expression.
explanation.definitionFit: Felicity can mean apt suitability, as in a well-chosen phrase.

clue.text: Called upon keen right-half to take on united, say

indicators.note: the right-hand half of the word keen is kept

parts.note: joined means united

explanation.surface: A keen footballer in the right-half position signs for United.
explanation.walkthrough: right-half is an old football position, a misleading sporting picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Enjoined means instructed or urged formally to act.

clue.text: The language of schoolboy, having swallowed last of strawberries

indicators.note: the schoolboy takes a letter into his middle

parts.note: an Etonian is a boy at Eton College, an elite English school

indicators.note: only the final letter of strawberries is used

explanation.surface: A pupil gulps down the final strawberry.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonian is the Finnic tongue spoken in Estonia.

clue.text: Given seat, being installed as bishop

definitions.meaning: placed on a throne or chair of state
a bishop is formally seated in the cathedral throne

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses describe a ceremonial seating, of a monarch or a new bishop.

clue.text: Peg needing a loophole?

parts.note: a short wooden peg fastens through a loop of cord on a coat, not a legal escape

explanation.definitionFit: A duffel-coat fastener is a wooden bar pushed through a loop.

clue.text: Old books to study on the way up to bridge in Venice

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament
a lair or den is a private study

explanation.surface: Ancient texts studied while climbing towards a Venetian bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the way up' turns the whole run of OT and LAIR backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rialto is the famous bridge over the Grand Canal.

clue.text: Peacock exhibition abandoned

parts.note: a show is an exhibition
an event called off is abandoned or cancelled

explanation.surface: A peacock display was cancelled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peacock' is a person who flaunts himself, not the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A vain person who preens is likened to a peacock, a flaunter.

clue.text: Lifeless district barricaded off by police

definitions.note: describes a zone rather than naming one; the answer is a noun

parts.note: having no go, or no energy, means lifeless
an area is a district

explanation.surface: A dead neighbourhood has been sealed off by officers.
explanation.definitionFit: A place sealed off and closed to entry is a zone forbidden to the public.

clue.text: Warning put up for Verne's captain

indicators.note: in a down clue putting up means writing bottom to top

parts.note: an omen is a warning sign

explanation.surface: A warning notice is posted for a famous fictional captain.
explanation.definitionFit: Captain Nemo commands the Nautilus in Jules Verne's novel.

clue.text: Inside cab, learner qualified

indicators.note: the letters run inside the words cab and learner

explanation.surface: A learner driver in a taxi passes their test.
explanation.definitionFit: Able means competent or fit for a task.

clue.text: Air of Italians taking drink and toast

definitions.meaning: a drinking song in Italian opera
the Italian word for a toast proposed over drinks

explanation.definitionFit: In Italian the word means a toast, and in opera a rousing drinking song.

clue.text: Like a small town with unique mount

parts.note: one can mean unique, the only
a horse is a mount for riding

explanation.surface: A small town known for having a single remarkable steed.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny, sleepy place is called a one-horse town.

clue.text: This poet is declared to be accomplished

indicators.note: declared means spoken, so the word is said out loud

parts.note: done means accomplished or finished

explanation.surface: A poet is announced to be highly skilled.
explanation.definitionFit: John Donne was the English metaphysical poet.
